user.title: Heating system
user.description: One heating system has one heat source. Rooms are added afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.heat_source_entity: Switch: the boiler relay. Climate: the ESPHome / DIYLess thermostat climate entity. OTGW: the OpenTherm Gateway climate entity. It receives the winning room target.
data_description.ch_switch: Optional. Turned on while any room is set to heat, off when no room is.
data_description.hysteresis: Switch only: start when a room is this far below its target, stop when it reaches it.

data_description.off_temperature: Sent to the heat source and TRVs when nothing should heat (frost protection).
data_description.presence_entity: Optional. home / on means somebody is home. Unknown counts as home.
data_description.away_mode: Rooms that are set to heat go off, or are lowered to their eco temperature.
data_description.skip_unchanged_writes: Saves TRV batteries. When off, the heartbeat also resends every TRV target.
data_description.external_temp_heartbeat: How often room temperatures are resent to TRV external inputs, even when unchanged (Sonoff TRVZB falls back to its own sensor after 2 hours).

data_description.experimental: Observe-only diagnostics: warm-up and PID advice, night cooldown prediction, gas per degree-day and an evening report. They never change the heating. On: the next page asks for the entities they use. What each feature does and how mature it is: [Experimental features]({docs_url})

experimental.title: Experimental features
experimental.description: All observe only: nothing here changes the heating. Every entity is optional; a feature runs once the entities it needs are set. What each feature does, what it needs and how mature it is: [Experimental features]({docs_url})

data_description.exp_room: Warm-up advice and the night model follow this room. Its warm temperature is the morning target.
data_description.exp_comfort_weekday: When the room should be warm in the morning; the night prediction says when heating would have to start.
data_description.exp_outdoor: Needed for gas per degree-day and the night model.
data_description.exp_weather: Hourly forecast for the night prediction.
data_description.exp_people: zone.home or a count sensor. Days nobody was home are left out of the gas figures.
data_description.exp_gas: Total gas meter (m³), with long-term statistics.
data_description.exp_flame: With hot water active and central heating active: splits each day's gas into hot water and heating.
data_description.exp_kp: Kp, Ki and Kd of a firmware PID (for example ESPHome). With all three set, warm-ups get tuning advice.
data_description.exp_gas_price_before6: Optional, shown next to the night prediction (for example Frank Energie).

data_description.overshoot_buffer: Added to the TRV targets only while this room drives the heat source.
data_description.drives_heat_source: Turn off for a room that may heat along but must never make the heat source run, such as a hallway that cools much faster than the rest of the house. Its TRVs still get its target and open while another room drives the heat source.

data_description.overshoot_buffer: Added to the TRV targets only while this room drives the heat source.
data_description.drives_heat_source: Turn off for a room that may heat along but must never make the heat source run, such as a hallway that cools much faster than the rest of the house. Its TRVs still get its target and open while another room drives the heat source.

data_description.trvs: Optional. A room without TRVs only adds heat demand.
data_description.external_temperature_inputs: Optional. Number entities that receive the room temperature (for example Sonoff TRVZB or Shelly BLU TRV).
data_description.window_sensors: Optional. Heating in this room pauses while any of them is open.

error.max_below_min: Maximum must be higher than minimum.
error.preset_out_of_range: Must be between minimum and maximum.
error.name_exists: A room with this name already exists.

pause_room.name: Pause room
pause_room.description: Hold a room off until resumed, keeping its mode and target.
